This is where you assemble your squad of (max) eight [[units]]. It allows to upgrade units by spending scraps (see [[Upgrade Times]]) or recyle units to create scrap. Squad Health is listed on the bottom above the "Scout" button. Squad Health is reduced by Squad Damage taken during PvE battles (e.g. mission & raid). If your squad health is reduced below zero, you squad is "Destroyed" and you cannot start PvE battles. Squad Health regenerates over time (about 5 points per minute, so >8h for a full bar of 2500).
